notes.title: Update 0.13 - Fishy Crabs
notes.notes:
[p][i]A Quick stroll to the beach ended up being a journey of new army inventions. Instead of using mechnical machines, this king believed the way to victory was taming the ordinary seeming wildlife. He also brought back some big rocks...[/i][/p][p]
Balance Adjustments[/p][list][*][p]Queen cost: 18 -> 20
[/p][/*][/list][p]Added[/p][list][*][p]New Piece: Flying fish, think a further reaching knight with less connected coverage[/p][/*][*][p]New Piece: Crab, though the humble crab cannot advance, it does skittle side to side and snip at anything close[/p][/*][*][p]New Piece: Rock, yup its just a rock. No rocks cannot suddenly move or capture. It doesn't cost anything as its just a rock... [/p][/*][*][p]New Achievements: Mom get the camera, My board my way[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial hints: short hints for new players (can be reset from menu)[/p][/*][*][p]Background image to forge[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Removed[/p][list][*][p]Resolution options, (this is now replaced by Fullscreen or a resizable window)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Changed[/p][list][*][p]Resolution options, (this is now replaced by Fullscreen or a resizable window)[/p][/*][*][p]Formations will now be unusable if they don't obey the current patches rules[/p][/*][*][p]Game should start in Fullscreen for new players[/p][/*][*][p]Audio options now immediately change sound instead of having to apply[/p][/*][*][p]Update win/loss screen to be a little clearer[/p][/*][*][p]Game Icons[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Fixed[/p][list][*][p]Excessive board offset in match[/p][/*][*][p]Bot achievement gained on loss[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed randomly being able to promote the dragon[/p][/*][*][p]Leaderboard names not loading[/p][/*][*][p]Wrong initial screen size[/p][/*][*][p]Corrupt game end path[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Release Date Announced
notes.notes: [p][i]Scouts have just come back from their excursion, all data indicates that there the fields of battle will soon be filled. The kings are set to clash their forces, in the coming months. Who will come out on top, nobody knows. How the various kings will ensure their victory is unclear, there will be many battles and opportunities for kings to come out on top.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Release date: [b]November 19th[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Before then be sure to check out the demo, let us know if you have any thoughts or suggestions, feedback is always welcome.[/p]

notes.title: Update 0.12 - Dragons Dominion
notes.notes: [p][i]It seems someone has managed to tame the beast beyond the lands, how shalt thou old formations fare against such a creature that breathes fire when coxed from its lair... How will the other kings react to this advancement?  [/i][/p][p][/p][p]Added[/p][list][*][p]Challenging friends, you can now challenge your online friends from the play menu[/p][/*][*][p]New Piece: Dragon, breathes fire consuming the 3 pieces in front cone.. will destroy your own units[/p][/*][*][p]Ability to quit AI games without surrendering[/p][/*][*][p]Boxy UI Rework[/p][/*][*][p]Pieces should now interact with certain lighting effects. E.g. the dragons breath[/p][/*][*][p]Background image for match[/p][/*][*][p]Display animations for the menus[/p][/*][*][p]Ability to cancel selecting formation[/p][/*][*][p]New icons for UI[/p][/*][*][p]Piece info now shows cost[/p][/*][*][p]Additional tooltips for main menu buttons[/p][/*][*][p]Intro animation (yes this is skippable, cause un-skippable intros are very annoying IMO)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Removed[/p][list][*][p]Depreciated networking features, these were left around from when the game was on itch instead of steam. removing them means they can't sneak any bugs into out formation and leads to a smaller download[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Changed[/p][list][*][p]Font & Sizes[/p][/*][*][p]Starting information for piece info card is now clear[/p][/*][*][p]Unit placer size[/p][/*][*][p]Formation select triggers on enter key[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Fixed[/p][list][*][p]Various issues with the new tamed beast (dragon)[/p][/*][*][p]Pieces not being taken vs AI[/p][/*][*][p]Status icon not showing correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Re-joining outdated lobbies in certain circumstances[/p][/*][*][p]Duplicate names showing in matches[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 0.11 - Assassins Ascent
notes.notes:
[p][i]Across Chessland kings compete for more than just land and resources, now the fight brings glory and renown to those that best their opponents. Who shall rise to the top and how will their fight to stay there play out?

[/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45685218/83dd2f1097ff0c3124c2f74f20b0f4d346329bbe.png"][/img][/p][p]This update main appeal is the introduction of ranked, with leaderboards for the top 10 players too.

Due to player count only 1 game mode and time format will be available at a time. Since we have added ranked, this updates mode will be ranked on rapid time (15m).[/p][p][/p][p]Added[/p][list][*][p]New piece: Assassin, a costly but deadly piece that can quickly move behind any open space behind a piece, capturing 3 squares behind[/p][/*][*][p]Unit information in the forge[/p][/*][*][p]Game type display at the top of matches[/p][/*][*][p]ELO V2: Elo is more fairly calculated and "exchanged"[/p][/*][*][p]AI V2: This AI has a very naïve understanding of board value, which means they are much more aggressive when they can take a piece[/p][/*][*][p]New challenge: How will your build fair to a queen filled attack? [/p][/*][*][p]Titles: Show off your flavour of tile, currently only 2 for owning either the demo or full game. Will be more in the future. (if you see "developer" then you are playing against our team)[/p][/*][*][p]Board textures: You can now choose from a set of board textures in the settings. E.g. Wood, stone, default[/p][/*][*][p]Ranked: Winning/Losing means more internet points, yay-yay[/p][/*][*][p]Leaderboards: Top 10 Global[/p][/*][*][p]New animations: Board/piece load[/p][/*][/list][p]Changed[/p][list][*][p]Matchmaking: Uses additional filters in the background to speed up queue times[/p][/*][*][p]Bigegg can no longer promote into itself[/p][/*][*][p]Allow right click to stop placing piece in forge[/p][/*][*][p]Searching now shows game mode[/p][/*][*][p]Removed AA from pieces, resulting in slightly sharper icons[/p][/*][*][p]Options and forge now give feedback on actions[/p][/*][/list][p]Fixed[/p][list][*][p]Connecting to old games[/p][/*][*][p]Settings not being defined[/p][/*][*][p]Cured AI analysis paralysis[/p][/*][*][p]Issues with going between bot and online matches[/p][/*][*][p]Surrendering sometimes not working[/p][/*][*][p]Pieces being invisible when placed[/p][/*][*][p]Tiling of scrolling main menu background[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.10.6
notes.notes:
[p][i]Big eggs were behaving weirdly, somehow using the enemies power against them. Though this look like it was a short lived advantage and whatever magic fuelling it fades.
[/i][/p][p] Added[/p][list][*][p]Ability to pin unit information screen during match, simply click to lock/unlock which stops it from moving offscreen so you can always see the detailed information[/p][/*][*][p]Exit game button on main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Version matching: You will now need to be on the same version to matchmake, from this version on players will be separated by version.[/p][/*][/list][p]Fixed[/p][list][*][p]Missing library capsule image[/p][/*][*][p]Game not winning upon capturing in some cases[/p][/*][*][p]Win/loss counting as 2 in some cases[/p][/*][*][p]big egg not using your own units for potential promotion[/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: DEMO is now available
notes.notes:
[p]Demo is now available, we would love it if you gave it a try and let us know your thoughts.

Currently the demo is up-to-date with the main game running on version 0.10.5, this will continue with the demo being kept to the same version as the main game. If this changes we will let you know.

How does the demo differ?[/p][list][*][p]Only matchmake against other demo players[/p][/*][*][p]Limited pieces (though we will be adding more to both the main game and demo)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you do decide to try the demo, we would love to hear what you think about it, the good and the bad. Honest feedback will help us improve the game and make it better for you and other players.[/p]

notes.title: Update 0.10.5
notes.notes:
[p][i]Many new players enter the increasing battles across Chessland, attempting to seize power. For now we can be confidant that they are merrily trying to gauge the strength of their own forces and test new compositions. Though I would warn everyone to keep your key on them, as those that appear weak today are likely to improve an untold amount.
[/i][/p][p]This update is focused on improving the game for the Demo. I've added in challenges, import/export of formations, many fixes... No new pieces yet though, they are still in the works.[/p][p]
Added[/p][list][*][p]Profile section: Elo, Wins, Loss, Played (Elo is currently only a testing stat and will not effect matchmaking, stats currently count AI games)[/p][/*][*][p]Challenges: These are preset formations to fight, Though you can use any formation you craft against them. The AI is very dumb but in the future these will be much harder and tied to achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Debug export: This is mainly for testing, won't be offering support for running/using this for the time being[/p][/*][*][p]Wishlist button: This will only be visible on the demo, takes you to the steam page[/p][/*][*][p]More play settings: time format, stating color[/p][/*][*][p]Import/Export: You can now import and export your formations from the forge. Allowing to share a formation with a friend.[/p][/*][*][p]Forge Visual Piece Placer: Now a little piece follows your mouse when placing a piece in the forge, look at him chase your mouse... funny little guy[/p][/*][/list][p]Changed[/p][list][*][p]AI doesn't copy your formation anymore, will use presets[/p][/*][*][p]About section uses markdown and offers a more readable entry, as well as direct links. Like other people who have put out work used in this game. Give them all some love![/p][/*][*][p]Sliders, settings menu got a slight visual update[/p][/*][*][p]Removed general setting, as this isn't currently used for anything[/p][/*][/list][p]Fixed[/p][list][*][p]AI being unnamed in practice[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed winning adding to your stats duplicate times[/p][/*][*][p]Tooltip spelling[/p][/*][*][p]Endless game when opponent disconnects[/p][/*][*][p]Stats disappearing after first load[/p][/*][*][p]Both players starting game as same color[/p][/*][*][p]Re-joining expired games[/p][/*][*][p]Searching breaking after playing game[/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

[p][i]A strange shimmer ripples across the chessboard, hinting at forces unseen. No, it's not a mischievous feline, nor a king's new contraption. it is that which binds all the pieces of chessemble, connecting them...
[/i]
I've been tirelessly working behind the scenes to move our networking infrastructure to steam, as this allows us to reduce costs and extend longevity. We have closed the old server ( which breaks old demos from itch, sorry :( ). But this should give us a more robust and long-lasting solution.

Added[/p][list][*][p]Hidden Elo (This doesn't affect matchmaking)[/p][/*][*][p]Tracked Stats: Win/Loss[/p][/*][/list][p]Changed[/p][list][*][p]Play modal now remembers last selected formation[/p][/*][*][p]Theme of searching match screen now inline with rest of game[/p][/*][*][p]Networking architecture -> steam @ Local[/p][/*][/list][p]Fixed[/p][list][*][p]Unable to match after playing AI game, or another online game[/p][/*][*][p]No formations selected on play screen[/p][/*][*][p]Local network not leaving match on surrender[/p][/*][*][p]Schrodinger's cat not starting with any available moves[/p][/*][*][p]Steam disconnect issue on surrender[/p][/*][*][p]Re-joining old matches[/p][/*][*][p]Modal heading not updating[/p][/*][*][p]Unable to stop matchmaking[/p][/*][/list]
